title: UK Skilled Worker Visa 2026: Requirements & Salary
metaDescription: UK Skilled Worker visa 2026: salary threshold 41,700 pounds, RQF 6 roles, B2 English, sponsorship rules, fees, documents and application steps explained.
headline: UK Skilled Worker Visa 2026: Complete Requirements Guide

sections.title: What the Skilled Worker Visa Requires
sections.content:
The Skilled Worker visa is the main UK route for sponsored employment. You need a confirmed job offer from a Home Office licensed sponsor, a Certificate of Sponsorship (CoS) reference number, a role at the required skill level, a salary that meets the threshold, and English at the required level. The CoS is a digital reference, not a physical document, and it records your job title, salary, start date and occupation code.

Since 22 July 2025, most new applicants need a role at RQF Level 6, which is degree level. This describes the job, not the applicant, so a self-taught developer can still be sponsored if the role genuinely matches a qualifying occupation code. Medium-skilled roles at RQF Levels 3 to 5 are only eligible through the Immigration Salary List or the Temporary Shortage List.

sections.title: The Salary Test: Thresholds and Going Rates
sections.content:
Every application faces a dual salary test: your pay must clear both the general threshold of 41,700 pounds a year and the published going rate for your occupation's SOC 2020 code, whichever is higher. An hourly floor of 17.13 pounds also applies across a maximum 48-hour week, and only guaranteed basic gross pay counts, so bonuses and allowances cannot bridge a shortfall.

Discounts exist for defined groups. New entrants, such as under-26s, recent graduates and those switching from a Student or Graduate visa, qualify at 33,400 pounds. Relevant PhD holders qualify at 37,500 pounds, STEM PhD holders at 33,400 pounds, and Immigration Salary List roles at 33,400 pounds with the full going rate.

sections.title: English, Documents and Fees
sections.content:
Since 8 January 2026, new applicants must prove English at CEFR level B2 in reading, writing, speaking and listening, through an approved Secure English Language Test, a degree taught in English, or nationality of a majority English-speaking country. Workers whose current Skilled Worker permission was granted at B1 may still extend at B1.

You must also show at least 1,270 pounds in maintenance funds, unless your sponsor certifies them, plus a valid passport and any required TB or criminal record certificates. Visa fees from 8 April 2026 are 819 pounds for up to three years and 1,618 pounds for longer, plus the Immigration Health Surcharge of 1,035 pounds per year.

sections.title: Application Steps and Settlement
sections.content:
Start by finding a licensed sponsor with a genuine vacancy at the right skill and salary level, then your employer assigns the Certificate of Sponsorship. You apply online with your CoS reference, passport, proof of English and maintenance evidence, and give biometrics at a visa application centre.

Standard processing takes around three weeks from outside the UK, with priority services available for faster decisions. The visa lasts up to five years and can lead to settlement through indefinite leave to remain, although the government is moving settlement toward an earned model, so check the current rules before relying on the five-year route.

faqs.q: What salary do I need for a UK Skilled Worker visa in 2026?
faqs.a: You generally need at least 41,700 pounds a year, or the going rate for your occupation code, whichever is higher, plus an hourly floor of 17.13 pounds. New entrants qualify at 33,400 pounds, relevant PhD holders at 37,500 pounds, and STEM PhD holders at 33,400 pounds. Only guaranteed basic gross pay counts toward these figures.

faqs.q: What skill level is required for the Skilled Worker visa?
faqs.a: Since 22 July 2025, most new applicants need a role at RQF Level 6, equivalent to degree level. The level describes the job rather than your qualifications. Medium-skilled roles at RQF Levels 3 to 5 can only be sponsored if they appear on the Immigration Salary List or the Temporary Shortage List.

faqs.q: What English level is needed for the Skilled Worker visa in 2026?
faqs.a: New applicants from 8 January 2026 must prove English at CEFR level B2 in all four skills, through an approved Secure English Language Test, a degree taught in English, or nationality of a majority English-speaking country. Workers already sponsored at B1 may extend their visa at B1.

faqs.q: How long does a UK Skilled Worker visa take to process?
faqs.a: Standard processing takes around three weeks from outside the UK once you have submitted your application and biometrics, with priority services available for faster decisions. The visa lasts up to five years, can be extended, and can lead to settlement through indefinite leave to remain.
